meta.title: Our Story
meta.description: The TZJ story — 16 years dedicated to emergency response training equipment, a history of continuous innovation and sustained industry growth.

hero.title: Our Story
hero.description: 16 years dedicated to emergency response training equipment — a history of continuous innovation and sustained growth at TZJ.

storySection.title: Starting from frontline needs
storySection.description: As communities grow more complex, fire departments need tougher, more reliable training tools. TZJ was born to meet that need — not just a vendor, but training specialists grown from real fire service and engineering experience.

valuesSection.title: Values that carry us forward every year
valuesSection.description: For 16 years, these commitments have led us to treat every project as a legacy worth building.

values.title: Quality First
values.desc: From materials to craftsmanship, we hold to high standards — facilities built to withstand time and live-fire training.

values.title: Continuous Innovation
values.desc: Ongoing R&D in thermal liner, modular systems, and more — leading industry evolution.

values.title: Safety Above All
values.desc: The safety of trainees and firefighters is the starting point of every design and build decision.

values.title: Long-Term Partnership
values.desc: From design through delivery and after-sales maintenance — we walk the full project lifecycle with our customers.

timeline.title: TZJ begins
timeline.desc: Founded by a team with fire service and engineering backgrounds, focused on steel training facilities built for fire service.

timeline.title: First steel training tower
timeline.desc: Delivered the first steel training tower — rugged and durable, replacing traditional masonry — still in service today.

timeline.title: Burn room thermal liner
timeline.desc: Introduced calcium silicate thermal liner system balancing durability and thermal protection.

timeline.title: Hot-dip galvanizing
timeline.desc: Adopted hot-dip galvanized steel across the product line, significantly improving corrosion resistance and service life.

timeline.title: Modular training system
timeline.desc: Launched all-galvanized steel modular training buildings with open floor plans, reconfigurable and stackable.

timeline.title: Hazmat training capability
timeline.desc: Added hazmat training props and mobile trailers covering broader emergency training scenarios.

timeline.title: Interlocking thermal liner
timeline.desc: Upgraded to interlocking thermal liner system — easier maintenance and improved thermal performance.

timeline.title: Nationwide and global
timeline.desc: 1000+ training complex projects across 31 provinces and international markets.
